name: Speed Duel: Match of the Millennium Starter Deck [1st Edition]
cleanName: Speed Duel Match of the Millennium Starter Deck 1st Edition
extDescription:
Each Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Speed Duel: Match of the Millennium Starter Deck contains:
• 1 x 31-Card Yugi Deck
• 1 x 31-Card Pegasus Deck
• 4 Skill Cards (2 for Yugi and 2 for Pegasus)
• 2 Ultra Rare variant cards

name: Speed Duel Decks: Match of the Millennium & Twisted Nightmares Display Box [1st Edition]
cleanName: Speed Duel Decks Match of the Millennium and Twisted Nightmares Display Box 1st Edition
extDescription: Each Display Box includes 4 Match of the Millennium and 4 Twisted Nightmares decks for a total of 8 decks, each with 66-68 cards.

name: Dark Magician
extDescription: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.

name: Gaia The Fierce Knight
extDescription: A knight whose horse travels faster than the wind. His battle-charge is a force to be reckoned with.

name: Curse of Dragon
extDescription: A wicked dragon that taps into dark forces to execute a powerful attack.

name: Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1
cleanName: Winged Dragon Guardian of the Fortress 1
extDescription: A dragon commonly found guarding mountain fortresses. Its signature attack is a sweeping dive from out of the blue.

name: Beaver Warrior
extDescription: What this creature lacks in size it makes up for in defense when battling in the prairie.

name: Celtic Guardian
extDescription: An elf who learned to wield a sword, he baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.

name: Silver Fang
extDescription: A snow wolf that's beautiful to the eye, but absolutely vicious in battle.

name: Giant Soldier of Stone
extDescription: A giant warrior made of stone. A punch from this creature has earth-shaking results.

name: Shadow Specter
extDescription: Powerful in groups, this animal spirit can be found in the wastelands.

name: Charging Gaia the Fierce Knight
extDescription: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If this card is Normal Summoned without Tributing, its original ATK becomes 1900. If this card is Tributed: You can add 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Charging Gaia the Fierce Knight" once per turn.

name: Senju of the Thousand Hands
extDescription: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Old Vindictive Magician
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Kuriboh
extDescription: During damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; you take no battle damage from that battle.

name: Magician of Faith
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand.

name: Sphere Kuriboh
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can send this card from your hand to the GY; change the attacking monster to Defense Position. When you Ritual Summon, you can banish this card from your GY as 1 of the monsters required for the Ritual Summon.

name: Black Luster Soldier
extDescription: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Black Luster Ritual".

name: Polymerization (A)
extDescription: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material.

name: Soul Release
extDescription: Target up to 5 cards in any GY(s); banish them.

name: Spell Shattering Arrow
extDescription: Destroy as many face-up Spell Cards your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each.

name: Spiral Spear Strike
extDescription: If "Gaia The Fierce Knight", "Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight", or "Gaia the Dragon Champion" you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If "Gaia the Dragon Champion" inflicts battle damage with this effect: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.

name: Twister
extDescription: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

name: Summoner's Art
extDescription: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Fighting Spirit
extDescription: The equipped monster gains 300 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. If it would be destroyed by battle, you can destroy this card instead.

name: White Elephant's Gift
extDescription: Send 1 face-up non-Effect Monster you control to the GY; draw 2 cards.

name: Goblin Circus
extDescription: During each of your End Phases: Reveal the bottom card of your Deck, then place it on the top of the Deck or banish it face-down.

name: Backup Squad
extDescription: Each time you take 1000 or more damage by your opponent's card effect or their monster's attack: Draw 1 card for every 1000 damage you took.

name: Spellbinding Circle
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack or change its battle position. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Magic Jammer
extDescription: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Eliminating the League
extDescription: Discard 1 Spell Card. Destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Check your opponent's hand, and all cards in their hand with the same name as the destroyed card are sent to the Graveyard.

name: Gaia the Dragon Champion
extDescription: "Gaia The Fierce Knight" + "Curse of Dragon"

name: Thousand-Eyes Idol
extDescription: A wicked entity that controls the hearts of men, its thousand eyes are able to see and expand the negative influences in an individual's soul.

name: Illusionist Faceless Mage
extDescription: Manipulates enemy attacks with the power of illusion.

name: Toon Alligator
extDescription: An alligator monster straight from the cartoons.

name: Red Archery Girl
extDescription: A mermaid archer that hides in a protective shell, waiting for the right moment to strike.

name: Manga Ryu-Ran
extDescription:
(This card is always treated as a "Toon" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Cannot be Special Summoned unless you control a face-up "Toon World". Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing the same number of monsters needed for a Tribute Summon (normally 2). This card cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 Life Points to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. This card can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon Monster. If they do control one, this card must target a Toon Monster for its attacks.

name: Toon Barrel Dragon
extDescription: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. Once per turn: You can target 1 card on the field; toss a coin 3 times and destroy it if at least 2 of the results are Heads.

name: Toon Buster Blader
extDescription: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. This card gains 500 ATK for each Dragon-Type monster your opponent controls or is in their Graveyard. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: Toon Dark Magician
Toon Summoned Skull
extDescription:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Cannot be Special Summoned unless you control "Toon World". Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing the same number of monsters needed for a Tribute Summon (normally 1). Cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 LP to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. This card can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster. If they do control one, this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks.

name: Toon Mermaid
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Cannot be Special Summoned unless you control a face-up "Toon World". Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing the same number of monsters needed for a Tribute Summon (normally 0). Cannot attack the turn it is Special Summoned. You must pay 500 LP to declare an attack with this monster. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. This card can attack your opponent directly, unless they control a Toon monster. If they do control one, this card must target a Toon monster for its attacks.

name: Toon Masked Sorcerer
extDescription: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

name: Toon Gemini Elf
extDescription: Cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

name: Illusionist Faceless Magician
extDescription: If a face-up "Eyes Restrict" Fusion Monster(s) or "Relinquished" you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon this card from the GY (if it was there when that monster was destroyed) or hand (even if not). If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can target 1 "Eyes Restrict" Fusion Monster or "Relinquished" in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Illusionist Faceless Magician" once per turn.

name: Sonic Bird
extDescription: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.

name: Djinn Prognosticator of Rituals
extDescription: When you Ritual Summon a monster, you can banish this card from your Graveyard as 1 of the monsters required for the Ritual Summon. If a player Ritual Summons using this card, if that Ritual Summoned monster inflicts battle damage to the other player, they discard 1 card.

name: Djinn Disserere of Rituals
extDescription: When you Ritual Summon a monster, you can banish this card from your GY as 1 of the monsters required for the Ritual Summon. The monster Ritual Summoned using this card is unaffected by Trap effects.

name: Relinquished
extDescription: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Black Illusion Ritual". Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead. While equipped with that monster, any battle damage you take from battles involving this card inflicts equal effect damage to your opponent.

name: Black Illusion Ritual
extDescription: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Relinquished". You must also Tribute a monster from your hand or field whose Level is 1 or more.

name: Polymerization (B)
extDescription: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material.

name: Toon World
extDescription: Activate this card by paying 1000 LP.

name: Toon Table of Contents
extDescription: Add 1 "Toon" card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Toon Rollback
extDescription: Target 1 Toon monster you control; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

name: Fulfillment of the Contract
extDescription: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Ritual Monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, banish the equipped monster.

name: Toon Mask
extDescription: If you control "Toon World": Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; Special Summon 1 Toon monster from your hand or Deck, whose Level is less than or equal to the Level/Rank of that monster, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

name: Seven Tools of the Bandit
extDescription: When a Trap Card is activated: Pay 1000 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Dust Tornado
extDescription: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your hand.

name: Shield Spear
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 400 ATK and DEF until the End Phase.

name: Security Orb
extDescription: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: Target that attacking monster; change that target's battle position. If this Set card is destroyed by your opponent's Spell/Trap effect and sent to the GY: Destroy 1 monster on the field.

name: Skill Successor
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 400 ATK until the end of this turn. During your turn, except the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 face-up monster you control; that target gains 800 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Thousand-Eyes Restrict
extDescription:
"Relinquished" + "Thousand-Eyes Idol"
Other monsters on the field cannot change their battle positions or attack. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead.

name: Advanced Ritual Art
extDescription: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any 1 Ritual Monster. You must also send Normal Monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal the Level of that Ritual Monster.

name: D.D. Crow
extDescription: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 card in your opponent's GY; banish that target.

name: Ritual of Black Mastery
extDescription:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase, while you control "Black Luster Soldier" or "Magician of Black Chaos" that you Ritual Summoned this turn.
• While you control "Black Luster Soldier", it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Skill, also once per turn, if your opponent activates a Trap Card, draw 1 card immediately after it resolves.
• While you control "Magician of Black Chaos", it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's Spell effects, also if your "Magician of Black Chaos" destroys a monster by battle, add 1 Spell from your GY to your hand.

name: Knight of Legend
extDescription:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Each turn, 1 "Gaia The Fierce Knight" you Normal Summon can be Summoned without Tributing. Apply the following Skills while you control a "Gaia The Fierce Knight" monster or a "Gaia the Dragon Champion" monster.
• If it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. Once per turn, if it inflicts battle damage with this Skill, draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
• You cannot activate Set cards in the Spell & Trap Zone.

name: Thousand-Eyes Spell
extDescription:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per turn, you can discard 1 card and use 1 of the following Skills, but you cannot conduct your Battle Phase this turn.
• Ritual Summon 1 "Relinquished" from your hand by Tributing a monster from your hand or field whose Level is 1 or more, also flip this card over.
• Fusion Summon 1 "Thousand-Eyes Restrict" from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material, also flip this card over.

name: Toon Mayhem!
extDescription: The first time each "Toon World" in your Spell & Trap Zone would be destroyed each turn, it is not destroyed.
